about.heading: About
about.copy: SkyCast shows live conditions and a 7-day forecast from Open-Meteo for any city in the world, or for your current location. Search, switch units and change language at any time.
footer.description: Thoughtful forecasts for wherever the day takes you.
footer.privacy_note: Your last city, units and language stay in your browser for up to 30 days. Your location is only used to fetch weather and is never stored.
